description: This file provides functions for handling hexadecimal representations of cryptographic hashes and object IDs in a version control system, including parsing, conversion, and algorithm-specific operations.

methods.name: int get_hash_hex_algop(const char * hex,unsigned char * hash,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to a hash using a specific algorithm.

methods.name: int get_hash_hex(const char * hex,unsigned char * sha1)
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to a SHA-1 hash.

methods.name: int get_oid_hex_algop(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an object ID using a specific hash algorithm, setting the algorithm used.

methods.name: int get_oid_hex_any(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Attempts to parse a hex string into an object ID using multiple hash algorithms.

methods.name: int get_oid_hex(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an object ID using the default hash algorithm.

methods.name: int parse_oid_hex_algop(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const char ** end,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an object ID with a specific algorithm, providing an end pointer.

methods.name: int parse_oid_hex_any(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const char ** end)
methods.description: Attempts to parse a hex string into an object ID using any known hash algorithms, providing an end pointer.

methods.name: int parse_oid_hex(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const char ** end)
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an object ID using the default hash algorithm, providing an end pointer.

methods.name: char * hash_to_hex_algop_r(char * buffer,const unsigned char * hash,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Converts a hash into a hexadecimal string using a specific algorithm, returning a buffer.

methods.name: char * oid_to_hex_r(char * buffer,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Converts an object ID to its hex string representation based on its algorithm.

methods.name: char * hash_to_hex_algop(const unsigned char * hash,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Converts a hash to hex string using a specific algorithm, with static buffers for reuse.

methods.name: char * hash_to_hex(const unsigned char * hash)
methods.description: Converts a hash to its hexadecimal string using the default algorithm.

methods.name: char * oid_to_hex(const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Converts an object ID to its hexadecimal string.
